prompt_summary: 我上个月消费金额是多少？

spans.name: schema_linking_sql_execution
spans.sql_template: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.amount_cents), 0) AS total_cents, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count FROM (SELECT _guard_orders.amount_cents, _guard_orders.created_at, _guard_orders.currency, _guard_orders.order_id, _guard_orders.quantity, _guard_orders.sku_id, _guard_orders.status, _guard_orders.tenant_id, _guard_orders.updated_at, _guard_orders.user_id FROM orders AS _guard_orders WHERE _guard_orders.user_id = :auth_principal_id AND _guard_orders.tenant_id = :auth_tenant_id) AS o WHERE 1 = 1 AND o.status IN (:spent_status_0, :spent_status_1, :spent_status_2, :spent_status_3, :spent_status_4) AND o.created_at >= :start_date AND o.created_at < :end_date LIMIT 200
